title: The Daily Compass｜每日罗盘
subtitle: A bilingual daily briefing for navigating global news, culture, AI, and social change.
theme: 主权、照护与叙事权：海地安全、伊朗协议、平等薪酬、文化记忆、AI依赖与数据中心污染
introChinese: 今天的小报关键词是：sovereignty, care, and narrative power（主权、照护与叙事权）。国家争夺安全与技术自主，劳动者争取被公平估值，文化机构争论历史该如何讲述，而 AI 数据中心则把看似虚拟的技术重新落回土地、能源与空气。

items.title: 海地新安全力量对抗帮派：会成为转折点吗？
items.summaryChinese: UN News 报道，海地新的安全力量正在加强对强大帮派的行动。长期政治失灵与武装暴力已经深刻影响首都太子港的日常生活。安全行动能否成为真正的转折点，不只取决于武力，也取决于法治、平民保护、公共服务与政治合法性能否同步恢复。
items.correspondingEnglish: UN News reported that a new security force in Haiti is intensifying operations against powerful gangs. Years of political dysfunction and armed violence have reshaped daily life in Port-au-Prince. Whether this becomes a real turning point depends not only on force, but also on the recovery of the rule of law, civilian protection, public services and political legitimacy.

englishExpressions.example: The new security force could mark a turning point for Haiti.
Security must be accompanied by the rule of law.
Public trust depends on political legitimacy.

items.title: 伊朗称和平协议取决于以色列撤出黎巴嫩
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，伊朗高级外交官 Abbas Araghchi 表示，美伊和平协议的推进取决于以色列军队撤出本轮冲突中占领的黎巴嫩领土，并称战争尚未完全结束。这说明双边协议无法与地区现实分开：停火文本、军队部署、边境安全和第三方承诺必须能够相互衔接。
items.correspondingEnglish: The Guardian reported that Iran’s top envoy, Abbas Araghchi, said progress on a peace agreement with the United States depended on Israeli forces withdrawing from Lebanese territory occupied during the conflict. He said the war had not fully ended. A bilateral agreement cannot be separated from regional realities, including troop deployments, border security and third-party commitments.

englishExpressions.example: The peace agreement remains dependent on regional conditions.
The envoy called for a troop withdrawal from Lebanon.
Diplomatic texts must account for regional realities.

items.title: 英国工会警告：Farage的平等薪酬方案可能让女性损失收入
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，英国工会批评 Reform UK 的平等薪酬立法计划，称其可能削弱女性现有权利。争议集中在“相同工作”与“同等价值工作”的区别：护理、零售等女性占比较高的职业即使岗位不同，也可能应当与价值相当的男性主导职业比较。政策是否真正保护女性，需要观察它如何评价长期被低估的劳动。
items.correspondingEnglish: UK unions warned that Reform UK’s proposed changes to equal-pay legislation could cost female workers money and weaken existing rights. The dispute centers on the difference between identical work and work of equal value. Jobs dominated by women, including care and retail work, may be different from male-dominated roles yet still deserve comparison when their value is equivalent.

englishExpressions.example: Unions said the proposal could weaken equal-pay protections.
The law allows comparison between jobs of equal value.
Care work is often treated as undervalued labor.

items.title: 英国学习障碍专科护士短缺被称为“绝对危机”
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，英国皇家护理学院警告学习障碍专科护士严重短缺，约150万名脆弱人群可能无法获得适当照护。专科护理常在公共讨论中不够可见，但它需要沟通能力、长期关系和对复杂需求的理解。人员短缺不仅增加等待时间，也可能让患者在整个医疗系统中更难被理解。
items.correspondingEnglish: The Royal College of Nursing described the shortage of learning-disability nurses in the UK as an “absolute crisis”. The Guardian reported that around 1.5 million vulnerable people may not be receiving appropriate care. Specialist nursing requires communication skills, long-term relationships and an understanding of complex needs; shortages can make patients less visible across the health system.

englishExpressions.example: Specialist nurses support patients with complex needs.
Staff shortages can prevent people from receiving appropriate care.
The health service faces a serious workforce shortage.

sections.heading: 艺术、时尚与媒体 / Art, Fashion & Media

items.title: 丘吉尔、孟加拉饥荒与美术馆中的历史争议
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，艺术家 Helen Cammock 为其在英国国家肖像馆展出的丘吉尔影像作品辩护。她关于丘吉尔与孟加拉饥荒责任的表达被批评为不实，艺术家则表示作品意在开启对话。这场争议显示，公共艺术既可以挑战英雄叙事，也必须面对事实准确性的问题；“引发讨论”不能自动取代证据。
items.correspondingEnglish: Artist Helen Cammock defended a video about Winston Churchill at the National Portrait Gallery after critics challenged its account of his responsibility for the Bengal famine. She said the work was intended to create dialogue. Public art can challenge heroic narratives, but it must also confront questions of factual accuracy. Starting a conversation does not remove the need for evidence.

englishExpressions.example: The artwork challenges a familiar historical narrative.
Public institutions must consider factual accuracy.
The artist said the work was designed to create dialogue.

items.title: Max Mara上海大秀：奢侈品牌如何借用“国潮”语言
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，Max Mara 在上海举行75周年时装秀，以骆驼色大衣和中国风格元素吸引中国奢侈品消费者。国际品牌拥抱“国潮”，既体现消费市场的重要性，也涉及文化符号由谁选择、如何翻译以及最终由谁获利。文化致敬与商业策略之间的边界，需要观察设计合作、语境和权力关系。
items.correspondingEnglish: Max Mara marked its 75th anniversary with a Shanghai catwalk show that combined its signature camel coats with references to Chinese style. The Guardian described the brand’s effort to appeal to Chinese luxury consumers through the language of guochao. Such projects raise questions about who selects cultural symbols, how they are translated and who profits from them.

englishExpressions.example: The show was designed for Chinese luxury consumers.
The collection uses several cultural references.
Cultural tribute can also function as a commercial strategy.

sections.heading: 人工智能与科技 / AI & Tech

items.title: 法国弃用Palantir AI数据工具，转向本土供应商
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，法国计划以本土公司 ChapsVision 的产品替代 Palantir AI 数据工具。法国总理将这一决定解释为减少对美国控制技术的“战略依赖”。政府数据系统的选择不只是采购问题，也涉及敏感数据、供应链控制、盟友关系和技术主权。
items.correspondingEnglish: France plans to replace Palantir’s AI data tools with technology from domestic provider ChapsVision. The Guardian reported that the government described the move as a way to reduce strategic dependence on US-controlled systems. Choosing government data infrastructure is not merely a procurement decision; it also concerns sensitive data, supply-chain control, alliances and technological sovereignty.

englishExpressions.example: The government wants to reduce strategic dependence on foreign tools.
France selected a domestic provider for the new system.
Public data systems have become an issue of technological sovereignty.

items.title: 美国司法部支持xAI，介入数据中心污染诉讼
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，美国司法部要求法官驳回 NAACP 针对 xAI 密西西比数据中心甲烷燃气轮机提起的污染诉讼。争议把 AI 基础设施与环境正义直接连接起来：计算能力依赖能源设备，而污染与健康成本往往由数据中心周边社区承担。AI 的收益和环境代价是否被公平分配，正在成为治理问题。
items.correspondingEnglish: The US Justice Department intervened in support of Elon Musk’s xAI in a pollution lawsuit over methane-gas turbines used at a Mississippi data center. The Guardian reported that the department urged the judge to dismiss the NAACP’s case. The dispute connects AI infrastructure with environmental justice: computing power depends on energy equipment, while nearby communities may bear pollution and health costs.

englishExpressions.example: The data center is facing a pollution lawsuit.
The facility uses methane-gas turbines to produce power.
Data-center expansion raises environmental-justice concerns.

englishParagraph.english: Today’s stories show that sovereignty is never purely abstract. It appears in security operations, troop withdrawals and the software governments choose for sensitive data. Care is also political: equal-pay rules decide how labor is valued, while nursing shortages determine whether vulnerable patients are understood. Cultural institutions shape public memory through artworks and exhibitions, but dialogue still requires factual responsibility. AI makes these connections especially visible because its infrastructure reaches into energy systems, local environments and national strategy. To ask who controls a system is also to ask who receives its benefits and who carries its costs.
englishParagraph.chinese: 今天的新闻显示，主权从来不是纯粹抽象的概念。它出现在安全行动、军队撤离和政府处理敏感数据时选择的软件中。照护同样具有政治性：平等薪酬规则决定劳动如何被估值，护士短缺则决定脆弱患者能否被理解。文化机构通过艺术与展览塑造公共记忆，但对话仍需承担事实责任。AI 尤其清楚地呈现这些联系，因为其基础设施深入能源系统、地方环境和国家战略。追问谁控制一个系统，也是在追问谁获得收益、谁承担代价。

keywords.meaning: 主权；国家或群体自主作出决定的能力
keywords.example: Data infrastructure has become an issue of technological sovereignty.

keywords.meaning: 政治合法性；权力获得社会认可的基础
平等薪酬；不因性别等因素受到工资歧视
keywords.example: Unions are defending existing equal-pay protections.
Public exhibitions should be attentive to factual accuracy.

keywords.meaning: 战略依赖；在关键系统中过度依赖外部供应者
keywords.example: France wants to reduce strategic dependence on foreign technology.

keywords.meaning: 环境正义；公平分配环境收益与污染成本
keywords.example: AI infrastructure raises questions of environmental justice.

sentenceLab.sentence: To ask who controls a system is also to ask who receives its benefits and who carries its costs.
sentenceLab.analysisChinese: 句子使用 To ask ... is also to ask ... 的平行结构，把“控制权”与“收益和成本的分配”连接起来。who receives 与 who carries 是两个并列的间接疑问结构。

reflection.english: Power becomes easier to see when we follow the path of data, care, memory, energy and cost.
reflection.chinese: 今天最想留下的一句话是：沿着数据、照护、记忆、能源与成本的流向追踪，权力就会变得更容易被看见。
